title: ruta obovata
intro: Ruta obovata, commonly known as Hairy Rue, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family, characterized by its hairy stems and leaves. The plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Ruta obovata include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Ruta obovata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
